projects.title: HeyTube
projects.subtitle: Edge Video Streaming Infrastructure
projects.description: A distributed edge-native video delivery platform engineered to eliminate latency, provide seamless 4K HDR streaming, and maintain high-fidelity playback across high-concurrency global networks.
projects.problem: Traditional centralized video hosting architectures suffer catastrophic latency spikes and buffer stalls when concurrent user loads surge beyond 50,000 requests.
projects.solution: Architected an edge-routed HLS/WebRTC streaming engine with smart segment pre-fetching, multi-region failover, and geo-distributed caching deployed across 42 Points of Presence (POPs).
projects.benefit: Reduced initial frame load latency by 68% (sub-10ms), achieved 99.99% playback uptime, and handled over 100k concurrent streams with zero frame drops.

projects.title: Institutional ERP
projects.subtitle: High-Availability Multi-Tenant Cloud Operating System
projects.description: An enterprise-grade institutional operating system powering centralized identity, real-time academic registries, financial audit trails, and multi-campus resource allocation.
projects.problem: Legacy institutional software operated on siloed on-premise relational databases, causing frequent data desynchronization, student registration crashes, and days-long financial reconciliation lag.
projects.solution: Built a fault-tolerant event-driven microservices architecture utilizing distributed ledger queues, role-based access control (RBAC), and automated read-replica sharding.
projects.benefit: Empowered 50,000+ daily active academic users, accelerated peak registration processing by 14.8x, and guaranteed 99.998% mission-critical ledger uptime.

projects.title: Telegram AI Bot
projects.subtitle: Autonomous Agentic Operations & Deployment Dispatch
projects.description: An autonomous developer agent orchestrating continuous integration, security vulnerability audits, and Kubernetes cluster deployments directly from secure chat interfaces.
projects.problem: Engineering leadership spent an average of 45 minutes per deployment manually checking syntax regressions, pulling server logs, and approving staging rollouts.
projects.solution: Engineered an agentic DAG pipeline combining structured LLM reasoning, sandboxed Git analysis, and bi-directional webhooks with granular permission gating.
projects.benefit: Reduced median CI deployment turnaround time from 45 minutes to 90 seconds, executed over 12,000 safe automated operations, and completely eliminated manual configuration errors.
